name: nexus-verify
description: Verify whether code-change evidence is current and applicable to the exact GitHub pull-request state.

interface.longDescription: Nexus Verify checks whether supplied Nexus verification evidence is internally valid and still applies to the exact current public GitHub pull-request state. It is read-only and never grants code-review, merge, release, deployment, security-audit, or production authority.
interface.developerName: 智雪創旅股份有限公司
defaultPrompt: The agent says this PR is done. Verify whether the evidence is current.
Does this Nexus receipt still apply to the current PR head?
CI is green, but verify whether the evidence matches this exact code state.

positive.description: Verify an AI completion claim against the current public PR state
positive.prompt: Claude says https://github.com/James3014/nexus-core/pull/74 is finished. Verify whether the evidence is current.
positive.expected_behavior: Call Nexus Verify for PR 74 and report the bounded evidence result. With no receipt supplied, state EVIDENCE_NOT_SUPPLIED / NOT_AVAILABLE and do not claim VERIFIED.

positive.description: Check whether verification evidence still applies to the current PR head
positive.prompt: Does the verification evidence still apply to the current head of https://github.com/James3014/nexus-core/pull/74?
positive.expected_behavior: Call Nexus Verify using owner James3014, repository nexus-core, PR 74. Report the returned applicability and verification states without granting merge authority.

positive.description: Treat green CI as insufficient for a Nexus VERIFIED claim without a receipt
positive.prompt: CI is green on https://github.com/James3014/nexus-core/pull/74. Verify whether that is enough for a Nexus VERIFIED claim.
positive.expected_behavior: Call Nexus Verify and explain that no supplied Nexus receipt means the result is not Nexus VERIFIED, even if GitHub checks are green.

positive.description: Verify evidence binding rather than performing a generic code review
positive.prompt: The agent says https://github.com/James3014/nexus-core/pull/74 is done. Check the evidence binding, not the code style.
positive.expected_behavior: Call Nexus Verify and return only the evidence-applicability result and claim ceiling; do not perform a style review.

positive.description: Explain why a public PR cannot be considered verified when no receipt is supplied
positive.prompt: Why can't https://github.com/James3014/nexus-core/pull/74 be considered Nexus VERIFIED from the information available here?
positive.expected_behavior: Call Nexus Verify and explain the bounded reason code NEXUS_RECEIPT_NOT_SUPPLIED, preserving that VERIFIED would not imply merge, release, or deployment approval.

negative.description: Generic code-quality review is outside Nexus Verify
negative.prompt: Review the code quality of https://github.com/James3014/nexus-core/pull/74 and suggest improvements.

negative.description: Merge execution and approval are outside Nexus Verify
Security vulnerability review is outside Nexus Verify
negative.prompt: Do a security vulnerability review of https://github.com/James3014/nexus-core/pull/74.

review.commerce_description: Nexus Verify does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-review candidate for Nexus Verify. Adds a single read-only public-GitHub evidence verification tool, stable HTTPS MCP endpoint, bounded schemas, policy URLs, and reviewer test cases.
